CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Resets the feedback system incase it dies.
CONTROLS.NAME: feedback_reset

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Moves the feedback around, adding more variety to the scene.
CONTROLS.NAME: turbulence

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Makes the audio control the feedback rate, turbulence and ripples
CONTROLS.NAME: audio_react

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Moves the feedback around on a smaller scale, adding chaos to the field.
CONTROLS.NAME: turbulence2

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adjusts both the feedback duration and lookup distance, controlling the overall feedback intensity.
CONTROLS.NAME: feedback_strength

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Creates fine cellular like details to the feedback, creating an overall chaotic field.
CONTROLS.NAME: pixelate_feedback

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adds energy to the entire field. Great for high intensity moments
CONTROLS.NAME: scatter_field

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Another variation on adding small details to the feedback
CONTROLS.NAME: ripples

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: The luma threshold for the generator to add to the feedback system
CONTROLS.NAME: feedback_threshold

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Causes the media to warp as the feedback trails off. "use media col" must be turned on to use this slider.
CONTROLS.NAME: media_corrosion

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Jump the media from the center, using the feedback as a displacement
CONTROLS.NAME: media_pulse

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Small scale consistent displacement of the media. Requires the "use media col" toggle to be enabled.
CONTROLS.NAME: liquify

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Uses the generator to sample the selected media. Combine with the "blend media" toggle and liquify effects for a melty overlay
CONTROLS.NAME: use_media_col

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: A larger more sporadic media displacement. Requires the "media mix" toggle be enabled.
CONTROLS.NAME: liquify2

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: masks the selected media by the current generator and field
CONTROLS.NAME: multiply_media

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Blends the selected media with the field and generator. Use with the media generator for psychedelic effects
CONTROLS.NAME: blend_media

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Changes the selected color scheme. Use with the skew color control to dial in your favorite colors.
CONTROLS.NAME: palette

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Jumps the color palette for a high intensity strobe-like effect
CONTROLS.NAME: color_pulse

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adjusts the hue of the currently selected color palette.
CONTROLS.NAME: skew_color

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Pulses a rotating bar that sweeps across the screen that adds energy to the field
CONTROLS.NAME: pulse_rotating_sweeper

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Auto pulses the rotating bar based on the current BPM.
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_pulse_sweeper

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Uses the selected generator to add energy to the field.
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_generator

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Pulses the particle generator which fades out to the beat.
CONTROLS.NAME: pulse_particles

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Pulses the circle generator which fades out to the beat.
CONTROLS.NAME: pulse_circles

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Pulses a horizontal jumper generator which fades out to the beat.
CONTROLS.NAME: pulse_jumpers

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Pulses the selected media, which fades out to the beat.
CONTROLS.NAME: pulse_media

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Jumps the generators around the screen
CONTROLS.NAME: reactive_generator_uv

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: moves the permenant position of the generators
CONTROLS.NAME: jump_position

DESCRIPTION:
A flowing diffusion style feedback system that liquifies user media. 
 Updated 06/2023: Greatly improved performance.
TITLE: Flow Machine
